name: pocket-cube
description: 魔方袖珍 Pocket Cube — 浏览器原生二阶魔方. 每关 par 由 8!x3^7 状态群上的完整广度优先扫描量出, 关卡在构建期生成并复验.

scripts.check: for f in js/*.js js/*/*.js server.cjs electron/main.cjs tools/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo OK
scripts.unit: ok=1; for f in test/*.test.mjs; do node "$f" || ok=0; done; [ "$ok" = 1 ] || exit 1
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run unit && node tools/docs-test.mjs

author: z-biz-game
